# pymolar

> Python interface to MolAR for molecular structures and trajectory analysis.
> Coordinates: nm. Time: ps. NumPy selection coordinates: (3, n), copied.

Read these repository documents in order:

- [Agent guide](docs/agent_guide.rst): capabilities, data sharing, units, limits, task-to-API map.
- [Selections](docs/selections.rst): syntax, global/local indices, tuple endpoints, operators.
- [Workflows](docs/workflows.rst): complete Python examples and trajectory task rules.
- [Python API types](python/pymolar/molar.pyi): exported names and call signatures.
- [Install and build](README.md): precision variants, optional formats, documentation build.
- [Coverage audit](docs/coverage-audit.md): evidence, corrected gaps, remaining implementation limits.

Critical rules: use rmsd_py, not rmsd. Use gyration(pbc=True), not gyration_pbc.
Use replace_state_deep(frame) to update existing selections; it swaps frame data.
Assign Fortran-contiguous arrays with the package's dtype to sel.coords.
Do not retain coordinate views across frame swaps or atom-count changes.
Python Sel already has topology/state references; no bind method is required.
There is no exposed Sel.sasa method or membrane analysis API in this version.
